goal: No shop or site file names an admin colour class, every admin colour that an admin part drawn on a public page reads has a value outside the admin in light and in dark, and the main button on Kaizena Flow's status and report pages is filled.
why: Thirteen admin colour roles have a value only under html[data-admin], yet 20 uses in seven shop and site files and 125 in eleven admin parts drawn on public pages read them: the submit button on /status and /report has a see-through background today. After: 0 uses in shop and site files (20 today), every role those parts name has a value under html:not([data-admin]), and the buttons have a computed background-color other than rgba(0, 0, 0, 0).

A unit scan test (node:fs, node:path, vitest). Read the helper style of src/app/admin/admin-type.scan.test.ts first. Pieces: (a) `const css = readFileSync('src/app/globals.css')`; `ROLES`: every name from the lines `--color-<name>: var(--<name>);` that sit between the comment 'The admin's colour roles' and the comment 'The admin's type scale and shapes' in the @theme block (regex over that slice: /--color-([a-z0-9-]+): var\(--\1\);/g). Expect ROLES to include 'line', 'card', 'brand', 'danger-text'. (b) `roleClasses(text: string): string[]` (exported): every match of new RegExp('(?<![\\w-])(?:[a-z0-9\\[\\]="-]+:)*(?:bg|text|border|ring|outline|divide|fill|stroke|accent|decoration|from|via|to)-(' + ROLES sorted longest first joined with '|' + ')(?![\\w-])', 'g'), returning the role names. (c) `sourceFiles(dir)`: every .ts and .tsx file under dir, recursive, without *.test.ts, *.test.tsx and *.d.ts. (d) `isAdmin(file)`: the path starts with src/app/admin/ or src/components/admin/. (e) `imports(file)`: the module paths of its value imports: every `from "X"` of an `import` or `export` statement that does not start with `import type` or `export type`, and every `import("X")`; resolve X that starts with '@/' to src/, and X that starts with '.' against the file's folder; try X.ts, X.tsx, X/index.ts, X/index.tsx; drop what does not resolve to a file under src, and drop anything under src/server. (f) `reached`: a breadth-first walk over imports() starting from every file of sourceFiles('src/app') and sourceFiles('src/components') that is not isAdmin; the set of isAdmin files the walk reaches (it follows imports out of admin files too). (g) `mapped`: the role names set in the block `html:not([data-admin]) {` of globals.css (regex /--([a-z0-9-]+):/g over the text from that selector to its closing brace), and `darkMapped`: the names set in both dark blocks (`html:not([data-admin]):not([data-color-mode="light"])` and `html:not([data-admin])[data-color-mode="dark"]`). Rule 1, 'the site's files speak the site's colour names': for every non-admin file of (c) that is not in `reached` (none is: reached holds admin files only), roleClasses(text) is empty; the failure message lists file and class. Rule 2, 'an admin part drawn outside the admin reads only colours that have a value there, in light and in dark': for every file in `reached`, every role of roleClasses(text) is in `mapped`; and every role in `mapped` whose value in the light block is a literal colour (starts with #) is also in `darkMapped` (the others follow site colours that have their own dark values). Would-notice cases: roleClasses('<i className="border-line hover:bg-sunken" />') equals ['line', 'sunken']; roleClasses('border-border bg-background text-inline') equals []; `reached` contains 'src/components/admin/action-form.tsx' and 'src/components/admin/text-styles.tsx'; and rule 2's check run with `mapped` minus 'brand' reports action-form.tsx.
